title: ai-rulez lock subject
description: Output of `ai-rulez lock --subject --format json`: the lock-subject digest a signature over the lock commits to, and the fields it is computed from.

type.description: The domain-separation label of the subject digest.

subject.description: The lock-subject digest: the value to sign.

tree.description: The top-level lock digest, recomputed from the entries.

approvals_digest.description: Digest of the [[approval]] and [[deny]] records of the lock; empty while the lock holds none.

scope.description: The [lock] scope the pins were written with (all or skills).
